eyebrow.zh: 固件 · 国产芯片 · 无符号

headline.zh:
让 agent 第一次
真正读懂固件

sub.zh: 把固件里的函数、调用、反编译结果变成 agent 能直接查改的对象——而不是日志里的一行文本。国产芯片固件，从此可被读懂。
sub.en: Functions, call graphs, and decompiled results become objects the agent can query and change — not just lines of log text. CN-SoC firmware, finally legible to agents.

title.en: Firmware is no longer a black box

body.zh: agent 自己追函数、追调用关系、读反编译——像读源码一样读固件，不用再靠手翻交叉引用。
body.en: The agent traces functions, call graphs, and decompiled code on its own — reading firmware like source, no more hand-trawling cross-references.

body.zh: 默认对接国产模型，不再迁就海外 API。车机 ECU、信创固件这些以二进制交付、符号稀缺的目标，第一次有 agent 能上手。
body.en: Built for CN models out of the box, no more bending to overseas APIs. Head-unit ECUs and 信创 firmware — delivered as binaries with scarce symbols — finally have an agent that can take them on.

chips: › 车机 ECU / 信创固件

title.en: See the skeleton in one command

body.zh: 不用先装一整套重型工具——单条命令列出函数表与调用关系，反编译随用随看。
body.en: No need to install a heavy toolchain first — one command lists functions and call graphs, decompilation on demand.

body.zh: agent 跨步骤记笔记、留线索，不会每轮从头来。逆到一半的上下文，下一次接着用。
body.en: The agent takes notes across steps and keeps its thread — not starting from scratch each turn. Half-done context picks up where it left off.

headline.zh: 给 agent 一个能上手固件的动作空间
headline.en: Give agents an action space that can work firmware
